narration: Meera takes home fifty thousand rupees a month. Her spending runs forty thousand.
caption: मीरा के हाथ में हर महीने 50,000 रुपये आते हैं। खर्च 40,000 का है।
image_brief: Meera, a woman in her thirties with shoulder-length black hair tied back, wearing a plain cotton kurta and a steel bangle on her right wrist, seated at a small dining table with a bank statement and a cup of tea, morning light from the window.

narration: Ten thousand is left over. Savings rate: twenty percent of take-home pay.
caption: 10,000 बच जाते हैं। बचत दर: हाथ में आई कमाई का 20 प्रतिशत।
image_brief: Two paper envelopes on a dining table, one thick and one thin, a pencil lying between them, morning light from a window.

narration: Her spending year is four lakh eighty thousand. Forty thousand, taken twelve times.
caption: उसका सालाना खर्च 4,80,000 है। चालीस हज़ार, बारह बार।
image_brief: A twelve-month desk calendar standing open on a shelf, every month tabbed with a small paper flag, soft daylight.

narration: Twenty-five times that is one crore twenty lakh. That is her target pot.
caption: उसका पच्चीस गुना है 1.2 करोड़। यही उसका लक्ष्य फंड है।
image_brief: A tall empty glass cylinder on a kitchen counter with a thin strip of tape marking a line near the rim, bright noon light.

narration: Ten thousand a month is one lakh twenty thousand saved in a year.
caption: हर महीने 10,000 का मतलब साल में 1,20,000 की बचत।
image_brief: A cloth pouch of coins on a table beside twelve small paper packets arranged in a row, warm lamp light.

narration: Against a target that size, that looks hopeless. It is not. Here is why.
caption: इतने बड़े लक्ष्य के सामने यह नाउम्मीद लगता है। पर है नहीं।
image_brief: A steep flight of stone steps climbing a hillside, the top lost in mist, early grey light.

narration: Convert it instead. Each year of work funds how many months of future spending?
caption: इसे बदलकर देखें। एक साल की कमाई आगे के कितने महीने चलाएगी?
image_brief: A metal kitchen scale with a small heap of rice on one pan and a much larger heap in a bowl beside it, window light.

narration: She saves ten thousand and spends forty thousand. That ratio is one to four.
caption: वह 10,000 बचाती है और 40,000 खर्च करती है। अनुपात एक और चार का।
image_brief: Four identical steel tumblers on a tray, one filled with water and three empty, afternoon light falling across the tray.

narration: So one year of work funds three months of her future life.
caption: यानी एक साल की मेहनत आगे के तीन महीने चलाती है।
image_brief: A twelve-slot pill organiser open on a shelf with only the first three slots filled with small coins, cool overhead light.

narration: Four years of work for one year of freedom. That is the exchange rate.
caption: चार साल की मेहनत, एक साल की आज़ादी। यही विनिमय दर है।
image_brief: Four bricks stacked in a low pile beside a single finished brick step on a dusty construction site, afternoon sun.

narration: Now the raise. Take-home moves up to sixty-five thousand a month.
caption: अब सैलरी बढ़ती है। हाथ में आने वाली रकम 65,000 हो जाती है।
image_brief: Meera's hands with a steel bangle on the right wrist holding an opened pay envelope, noticeably thicker than before, over the same dining table, morning light.

narration: Version one. Spending climbs to fifty-two thousand, so saving becomes thirteen thousand.
caption: पहला रास्ता: खर्च 52,000 हो जाता है, बचत 13,000 रह जाती है।
image_brief: A household shopping basket on a kitchen floor piled higher than usual with vegetables and packets, light from a doorway.

narration: Thirteen out of sixty-five is twenty percent. The fraction never moved.
caption: 65,000 में से 13,000 यानी 20 प्रतिशत। अनुपात वहीं का वहीं रहा।
image_brief: Two glass tumblers of different sizes on a counter, tea filled to exactly the same fraction of each, warm light.

narration: Her spending year is now six lakh twenty-four thousand. The target follows it upward.
caption: अब सालाना खर्च 6,24,000 है। लक्ष्य भी उसी के साथ ऊपर चढ़ जाता है।
image_brief: A ledger book lying open flat on a table with one column of handwritten figures noticeably longer than the column beside it, lamp light.

narration: Twenty-five times that is one crore fifty-six lakh. Thirty-six lakh added.
caption: उसका पच्चीस गुना है 1.56 करोड़। छत्तीस लाख और जुड़ गए।
image_brief: A tall stack of banded note bundles on a steel trunk with three extra bundles set on top, dim storeroom light.
